info.title: Ameku M.D.: Doctor Detective
info.synopsis: Nel reparto di diagnostica generale dell'ospedale Tenikai vengono raccolti tutti i pazienti che vengono ritenuti dai medici troppo difficili da curare. Senza contare tutti i casi di omicidio e misteri con cause sconosciute che nemmeno la polizia è in grado di gestire. La geniale dottoressa Takao Ameku riesce a rivelare la scioccante verità dietro queste situazioni ingestibili per le persone normali.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Ameku Takao is a genius doctor with a knack for solving all kinds of difficult cases. When a man with blue blood is brought to Tenikai General Hospital—where Takao is the vice-director—after having his leg bitten off by a large beast, she starts investigating the intriguing case with the aid of her colleague, Takanashi.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Takao comes to the conclusion that the "large beast" responsible for severing the man's leg was, in fact, a Tyrannosaurus Rex. Following this shocking deduction, the case rapidly develops, and she and her crew head to the place where they hope to get answers to the remaining mystery of the victim's blue blood.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: "Do you believe a video can be cursed?" A girl walks in front of a train after watching a particular video and is subsequently admitted to a psych ward. Takao is the only one who believes her twin sister when she says it wasn't a suicide attempt but the result of watching a cursed video, and the genius doctor sets about investigating.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: "All who desecrate my grave shall be cursed to die." A university research team examining a grave reportedly linked to renowned onmyoji, Ashiya Doman, have started complaining about not feeling well, one after another. Takao is asked to investigate, but the case takes an unexpected turn.
